design.decision: Buy [♦] cards and length-making enablers over honors, and bid knowing a [♦]-heavy hand both pays and is likely to be trumped.
design.opponent: Shown after bidding; opponents void [♦] early and trump it to set a team whose multiplier now cuts both ways.
design.rationale: Whole-hand counts measure well. This is the compounding top end of the [♦] length line: about ×1.9 at an average 6.5 [♦]s, and it grows with the cards and enablers a run buys. It works without enablers but rewards them, and a set hurts more.
design.draftText: ×1.1 contract multiplier for each [♦] your team holds

critic.concerns: Compounding per held card (~×1.1^6.5) is opaque to read and changes only purchases and bids, never a play.
